s: God tells Hosea to marry an unfaithful wife as a sign of Israel's unfaithfulness. Their children's names carry God's message.
God will allure unfaithful Israel into the desert and speak to her heart, and take her back as his bride.
Hosea buys back his wife, a sign that God will restore Israel.
God has a case against Israel: there is no knowledge of God in the land.
Judgment on the priests and the house of the king.
Come, let us return to the Lord. God desires mercy, not sacrifice.
Israel's wickedness and its trust in foreign powers.
Israel has sown the wind and will reap the whirlwind.
Israel will be punished for its idolatry.
Israel is a luxuriant vine that grew more altars.
When Israel was a child I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.
Ephraim's lies, and God's memories of Jacob.
Israel's idolatry will lead to its ruin.
Samaria will fall. Return to the Lord, and he will heal your faithlessness.
